<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Release the next highest-priority work unit on a process path"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/paths/{pathId}/release"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Applies the release policy to a process path's `WorkPool` — the ReleaseNextWork use case. Admits the pending work unit with the earliest (most urgent) CPT, transitioning it Pending → Released. This is continuous, priority-ordered admission (waveless), not a batch/wave release. A release-fed pool enforces its WIP limit as a hard invariant: releasing past the limit fails with `409`. Publishes `WorkReleased`, which downstream fulfillment-execution consumes to create a Task. This is a collection-level command on the path's work pool (not scoped to a single work unit id, since the caller does not choose which unit is released — the priority policy does), analogous in REST terms to a resource-scoped bulk action.

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"name":"pathId","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The process path's identifier — a named station that owns a queue (unit-in → unit-out), e.g. a pick zone or pack line. Must belong to a process-path family declared in this deployment's process-path catalogue (ADR-0012; today the fleet's sortable-fc topology declares the pick/pack/rebin/slam families, each optionally carrying a \"-\"-delimited station/zone suffix, e.g. pick-a or pack-station-1). The write endpoints (receiveChargeForecast, commitShiftPlan, enqueueWorkUnit) reject ids outside the declared families with `400 unknown-path-id`; read endpoints surface a missing pool/projection as `404` instead.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"pattern":"^(pick|pack|rebin|slam)(-.*)?$"},"example":"pick-a"}]}
>
